content: clang-tidy: checks are grouped into named modules (e.g. modernize, performance, bugprone) registered via llvm::Registry<ClangTidyModule> (ClangTidyModuleRegistry); each check has a dotted-ish name (module-check-name) selected via glob include/exclude lists (-checks=). This is the closest real precedent to mediadiff's checks.def X-macro registry + glob include/exclude for --set. clang-tidy does NOT enforce 'every check has docs' at build time the way mediadiff proposes; docs are maintained by convention/CI script, not compile-time enforcement -- mediadiff's build-fails-on-missing-doc rule is stricter than the precedent.
